Lower Camp - 810100 Lower Camp Lower Camp _Camp Hours are 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM_ for campers age 4 to entering Grade 1 Lower Camp combines the best of our former Tricon and Minute Kids programs into one thoughtfully designed camp experience for our youngest campers.This program offers a gentle introduction to summer camp with age-appropriate activities in a nurturing, structured environment. Campers enjoy outdoor exploration, swimming, creative crafts, group games, and guided free play that supports social development, confidence, and independence. Small group experiences and consistent routines help children feel safe, supported, and excited to come to camp each day.
